facts.text: Restricted Activities section applies to evaluation and funded phases: “unexplained risk changes” and “disproportionate event risk”; actions may include “payout rejection or cancellation” and removal of profits. Overall assessment is not a quantified limit.
facts.locator: Restricted Activities, High-Risk, Gambling, and Exploitative Trading Practices

facts.text: Same section states “Leverage, different position sizes, market specialisation, multiple challenges or trading around events do not automatically constitute a breach”; overall activity and evidence assessed. No formal appeal route established.
Guaranteed payout processing within three business days from approval or $300 compensation, excludes compliance reviews and third-party delays. Not a guarantee of approval.
30 consecutive days inactivity: contract automatically terminates; “any remaining balances considered null and void”. Scope of earned/approved rewards not established.

rejected.B1: Right to terminate service at any time does not expressly remove earned rewards independent of breach. Conduct-linked cancellation B2.
rejected.B3: Last updated clause permits updating terms with continued use; restricted country list amendment reflects AML. Neither expressly applies new trading rules to existing purchased accounts.
rejected.E_HARSH: 30-day inactivity forfeiture refers to remaining balances, not explicitly earned payouts; do not double count as procedural harsh sanction without clarification.
rejected.CONS_INFO: Promotional free/giveaway payout cap and 50/50 split excluded by handoff.
